# Phillips & Sam

- [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) — Commands — [Sam](../character/sam.md) — student in class · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), with Matthew's help, to let her go to a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert and driving with Diana's cousins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed only to leap on top of Diana's sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who becomes furious.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession
